release_title: JOSHY Audio Playback Suite v1.0.0 (Accessible Edition)
changelog: New accessible shortcuts and telemetry verification.

installer.title: JOSHY Windows Installer
installer.target_audience: Blind and visually impaired users with NVDA, JAWS, or Windows Narrator. Installs desktop & start menu shortcuts and handles automatic extraction.

portable.title: JOSHY Standalone Portable Executable
portable.target_audience: Single-binary native C machine-code executable. Runs instantly from USB or disk without administrative rights or installation.
